name: starter-p2-regional-reefer-weekly
about: Starter P2 "The number" on the opening-regional-reefer-weekly brief (the owner's copy rating, 2026-11-12).

recipe.name: The number
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with the pay figure alone, exactly as the brief states it and with its unit (per mile, per week, per year). If the brief states no pay, lead with its strongest other figure (a bonus, home days, miles) — never a figure the brief does not hold. Who the job is for (the licence, the kind of run) goes in a few words on the small line above it, never in the pay line.
recipe.image_prompt_template: A plain {surface} background, {texture}, {light}, a soft {tone} gradient, nothing in the frame, no text, no logos, no lettering

en.primary_text: Silvicom Inc is hiring regional reefer drivers for Chicago-to-Texas lanes. You haul no-touch freight, get paid weekly, and are home weekly. Rates run $0.62 to $0.70 per mile depending on experience. You need 2 years of experience and must be 23+. Join our team.
en.headline: Home weekly, weekly pay

es.primary_text: Silvicom Inc busca conductores de tráiler refrigerado para rutas regionales de Chicago a Texas. Carga sin tocar mercancía, pago semanal y regreso a casa cada semana. La tarifa es de $0.62 a $0.70 por milla. Se requieren 2 años de experiencia y ser mayor de 23 años.
es.headline: En casa cada semana
